verdict.rationale: Glama Chat lets users upload PDFs, Word docs, or text files and get instant AI answers with exact page references. It also offers access to leading models and side-by-side response comparison, so users can get AI-generated answers from their own documents inside the product. There is no evidence of proactive AI insights or suggestions drawn from in-product data such as gateway call logs or server usage. Missing for 10: proactive AI-generated insights/suggestions over product data (e.g., gateway logs, server analytics), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the document Q&A feature.
